basic_info.description: Experience luxury living at 72 Townsend St, Unit 302, in San Francisco's vibrant South Beach neighborhood. This spacious, 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence features hardwood floors throughout and is move-in ready. The highlight of this home is its expansive, deeded terrace/patioperfect for outdoor entertaining or relaxation.  Designed with high-end finishes, the unit boasts a professional-grade kitchen with European Studio Becker cabinetry, Caesarstone countertops, and top-of-the-line Bosch and Thermador appliances. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into well-appointed interiors, offering comfort and sophistication at every turn.  Residents of 72 Townsend enjoy exclusive amenities, including a stunning outdoor sky lounge with sweeping views of the city and the bay. Located just steps away from some of San Francisco's finest dining and entertainment options and near Oracle Park, CalTrain, and the 280/101, 72 Townsend is a prime waterfront location.
